masks.reason: Both golden images are app-produced client/framebuffer surfaces and contain no operating-system chrome.

masks.scope: ImGui text glyph pixels outside scientific media
masks.reason: Roboto/Fork Awesome rasterization differs between Metal and OpenGL. Text content and anchors are checked from the ImGui semantic snapshot instead.

masks.scope: File Browser, Frame Inspect, Diagnostics, buffer list, stimulus timeline, and analysis timeline interiors
masks.reason: Backend diagnostics and write/inference controls are platform adapters or explicitly deferred. Window role, ordering, visibility, and outer bounds remain exact checks.

masks.scope: Linux camera plot area outside viewports.camera_media
masks.reason: Maintained redgui owns ImPlot axes while the Metal adapter records the fitted media rectangle directly.

masks.scope: Camera areas outside the declared clean source regions
masks.reason: ROI/stimulus insets and their text labels use renderer-specific raster paths. Their availability and geometry are separately asserted by state markers.

masks.scope: Production camera overlay labels and small on-screen mask/vector raster
masks.reason: At this display scale the scientific subject occupies fewer than 20 pixels and is obscured by renderer-owned labels/insets. Frozen mask IoU, vector coverage, outlier, and channel thresholds are enforced by apple_read_only_overlay_metal_tests at a controlled resolution; Linux enforces the same source geometry contract in overlay_scene_contract_tests.
